codeVersion.seedDerivationRule: seed(domain, i) = first 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(key = hex-decoded masterSeed, message = "<seedDerivation>:<domain>:<i>")
codeVersion.independentReplay: replay/replay-bootstrap.py (Python standard library only; imports nothing from this repository)

masterSeedScope: ALL THREE passes of this run. Pass 0, Pass 1 and every Pass-2 bootstrap replicate derive from it.
recordingNote: The master seed was generated once, as 32 random bytes, for the 2026-09-12 run and recorded before any experiment ran; since 2026-09-24 it is pinned in src/config.ts, so the committed experiment is regenerated rather than redrawn. This statement describes the procedure; repository metadata cannot independently authenticate when the seed was first generated.

pass0_reference.experiment: Finite 8-deck RTP of the rule set over a fair shuffle
pass0_reference.drawRule: uniform index in [0, n) by rejection: reject any 32-bit word >= floor(2^32 / n) * n, then take the remainder

pass1_real_shoe.experiment: First-card rank uniformity and serial independence of the real blackjackShoe algorithm

pass2_bootstrap.experiment: Cherry-pick detection on the served window: the money statistic (primary, every nonce settled under the declared basic strategy, 50-round windows) and the first-card rank screen against a parametric bootstrap null (secondary)
pass2_bootstrap.statistic: first-card rank chi-squared over the early window; at n=50 the expected count per rank is 50/13 = 3.85, so chiSquaredTest pools the two end bins and the statistic is an 11-bin chi-squared on df 10. The null uses the identical statistic.
pass2_bootstrap.nullFormat: IEEE-754 float64 little-endian, GENERATION order (index r = replicate r), one value per replicate

supersededArtifact.note: The 2026-09-02 simulation this release replaces. Its random inputs were never recorded and cannot be recovered, so it is retained as a FROZEN TEST FIXTURE with its digest pinned in src/config.ts (LEGACY_SIMULATION_SHA256) — not as a reproducible result, and not as the artifact of record.
